cells.scene: A scientist compares several samples in clear dishes under a magnifier and carefully records differences, systematic examination.
A magnified microscopic view contains several simple rod-shaped and spherical bacterial cells, tiny cellular scale suggested by a microscope inset, no viruses or monster faces.

A simple educational molecular view shows paired oxygen atoms as identical connected spheres beside a healthy breathing person and a small air-flow symbol, no false atom counts or hazardous equipment.
An astronomer works within a clearly defined area of expertise, telescope and star chart grouped around the scholar while another field's tools remain separate.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — analyse (v.分析): A scientist compares several samples in clear dishes under a magnifier and carefully records differences, systematic examination.
TOP RIGHT — bacteria (n.细菌): A magnified microscopic view contains several simple rod-shaped and spherical bacterial cells, tiny cellular scale suggested by a microscope inset, no viruses or monster faces.
BOTTOM LEFT — oxygen (n.氧气): A simple educational molecular view shows paired oxygen atoms as identical connected spheres beside a healthy breathing person and a small air-flow symbol, no false atom counts or hazardous equipment.
BOTTOM RIGHT — realm (n.领域): An astronomer works within a clearly defined area of expertise, telescope and star chart grouped around the scholar while another field's tools remain separate.
CROP SAFETY: each scene is SMALL, at most 60% of its quadrant, with 20% white margins. Top drawings fully end ABOVE 45% image height. Bottom-row heads, hair, thought bubbles and main objects begin BELOW 58% total image height. Nothing crosses midlines. Sparse background detail, light watercolor.
review_notes: Reviewed meanings, contained silhouettes and anatomy. Bacteria use rods/cocci rather than viruses; oxygen shows two equal atoms. Flood senses of overtake/spell/sweeping respected.
